name: Undercity
description: The surface district beneath Towashi's skyscrapers where Tameshi's secret meeting takes place.

timeline.summary: Sobeslav uses a spell on the mushroom to find the meeting place and leads the guards on a three-day descent below the Undercity.
timeline.quote: On their third morning of journeying, Sobeslav called his guards to a halt.

citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Kaito tracks Tameshi to the Undercity docks and sends Himoto into a warehouse laboratory.
timeline.quote: Silently, she flew toward the warehouse.
